```artifact
Feature: Admin manage specialities and doctors

  As an admin, I want to manage specialities and doctors so that I can maintain a well-organized medical staff.

  Scenario: Adding a new speciality
  Given I am logged into the admin system
  When I add a new speciality
  Then the speciality should be created with a unique identifier

  Scenario Outline: Viewing and updating specialities
  Given I am logged into the admin system
  When I view a speciality
  Then the speciality details should be displayed
  When I update a speciality
  Then the speciality details should be updated

  Scenario Outline: Deleting a speciality
  Given I am logged into the admin system
  When I delete a speciality
  Then the speciality should be removed from the system
  When I attempt to delete a speciality with doctors attached
  Then an error should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Maintaining doctors
  Given I am logged into the admin system
  When I associate a doctor with a speciality
  Then the doctor should be linked to the speciality
  When I disassociate a doctor from a speciality
  Then the doctor should be removed from the speciality

  Examples:
    | Speciality Name | Speciality ID | Doctor Name | Doctor ID |
    | Cardiology      | 001           | Dr. Smith   | 101       |
    | Neurology       | 002           | Dr. Jones   | 102       |

  Scenario Outline: Adding a new doctor
  Given I am logged into the admin system
  When I add a new doctor
  Then the doctor should be created with a unique identifier
  When I associate a doctor with a speciality
  Then the doctor should be linked to the speciality

  Scenario Outline: Updating doctor information
  Given I am logged into the admin system
  When I update a doctor's information
  Then the doctor's information should be updated

   "preconditions": ["I am logged into the admin system"], "inputs": {"name": "Speciality Name"}, "steps": ["I view a speciality", "Speciality details should be displayed", "I update a speciality", "Speciality details should be updated"], "expected": ["Speciality details should be updated"]},
  {"id": "TC-003", "title": "Delete a speciality", "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-4.2-4", "Req-1/3"], "kind": "negative",

  {"id": "TC-004", "title": "Associate a doctor with a speciality", "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-4.2-5", "Req-2/1"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["I am logged into the admin system", "Doctor is not already linked to a speciality"], "inputs": {"name": "Doctor Name", "name": "Speciality Name"}, "steps": ["I associate a doctor with a speciality", "Doctor should be linked to the speciality"], "expected": ["Doctor should be linked to the speciality"]},
  {"id": "TC-005", "title": "Disassociate a doctor from a speciality", "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-4.2-5", "Req-2/2"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["I am logged into the admin system", "Doctor is already linked to a speciality"], "inputs": {"name": "Doctor Name", "name": "Speciality Name"}, "steps": ["I disassociate a doctor from a speciality", "Doctor should be removed from the speciality"], "expected": ["Doctor should be removed from the speciality"]},
  {"id": "TC-006", "title": "Update doctor information", "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-4.2-5", "Req-2/3"], "kind": "positive",
   "preconditions": ["I am logged into the admin system", "Doctor is already linked to a speciality"], "inputs": {"name": "Doctor Name", "name": "Speciality Name"}, "steps": ["I update a doctor's information", "Doctor's information should be updated"], "expected": ["Doctor's information should be updated"]}
]
